source: public Instagram trend discovery (social.search, platform=instagram, ranked by engagement)

trends.details: Holiday party dressing goes sequin and satin. A 520K-like winter editorial carousel opens the day: a snowy shoot with a brown puffer jacket with a green star pattern, cream gloves and a thick knit hooded scarf, plus elevator selfies in a pale yellow coat. A 34K-like 'Zara Xmas Looks' reel models five holiday outfits — black satin wide-leg trousers with a sequin bomber, a sheer beaded top, an all-white halter look, a black-and-gold embroidered cropped jacket, and a black sequined halter maxi dress. A 27K-like 'Holiday Dresses' showcase presents five evening looks: a black satin-and-lace mermaid midi, champagne satin, a burgundy floral jacquard gown, navy velvet and olive satin. A 26K-like reel goes bold with a chartreuse sequin holiday party outfit — a lime-green sequined mini skirt with an oversized ribbed sweater and silver heels.
trends.title: Holiday party dressing goes sequin and satin — Zara Xmas looks, five-dress showcases, chartreuse sequins

trends.details: Handmade Christmas tree garlands take over the mantel. An 88K-like silent tutorial knots a macrame Christmas tree garland — dark green cord looped around a brown core into little trees with tassel trunks and wooden stars, strung on white rope and hung across a fireplace mantel. A 34K-like craft reel folds green paper into three-dimensional trees with gold star toppers, strung on red-and-white twine and hung over a dark wood cabinet under fairy lights. A 32K-like home video assembles a large tree with warm lights, deep red velvet ribbons, plaid bows and dried hydrangeas, plus a magnolia-and-hydrangea garland across a white mantel. An 18K-like mantel tutorial layers cedar garland with red berries, tucks in illuminated ceramic gingerbread houses, hangs four stockings and finishes with a 'JOYEUX NOEL' candle under a giant red-and-white striped bow.
trends.title: Handmade Christmas tree garlands take over — macrame trees, paper trees, hydrangea mantels

trends.details: 'Cold girl' makeup goes viral. A 290K-like reel tries the 'cold girl' makeup trend: black winged liner, bright pink blush dabbed on the cheeks and the tip of the nose for a flushed-from-cold look, glossy lips and a plaid scarf to finish. A 38K-like look posted this morning pairs 'Olive meets Burgundy' — olive-green eyeshadow with burgundy winged liner and matching burgundy lipstick under a burgundy leather jacket. A 17K-like winter holiday glam tutorial builds soft curls, rosy cheeks, glossy lips and shimmery pink eyes with Armani Luminous Silk and the Flower Knows Strawberry Rococo palette. A 6.9K-like 'everyday snow fairy glow' routine layers a Dior Backstage Glow palette on cheekbones with white winged liner and pink blush.
trends.title: 'Cold girl' makeup goes viral — flushed cheeks, glossy lips, olive meets burgundy
